items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: but Louie Kepard, who I think would, who worked with Oliver at that same period.

ctx.x: So Bunk was dead before I took the other three corners, but Louie Kepard, who I think would, who worked with Oliver at that same period. Uh-huh.

Well, let me tell you another memory I have of Joe Oliver that was funny. Although he was only 16 or something like that at the time, if my memory serves me right. He was, I see, much older to a kid who was four years old, five years old. And I was struck by what beautiful white teeth he had. And he always chewed a hunk of tar. You know that black stuff? Oh, yeah. They always chewed that.
